title: Vitamin D Analog in Vitamin D 24-hydroxylase Deficiency
official: Preclinic Evaluation of a Vitamin D Analog in Vitamin D 24-hydroxylase Deficiency
summary: Preclinical evaluation of a vitamin D analog for the treatment of vitamin D 24-hydroxylase using fibroblast from patients with CYP24A1 mutation.
criteria:

* biallelic mutation in CYP24A1
* consent
